status: REFERENCE-BASED, EMPIRICAL. Learned lag-1 TICA spans vs the reference-estimated time-t optimum V_m(S_t-hat); the envelope is a Davis-Kahan EMPIRICAL SENSITIVITY ENVELOPE with e_t = 3 ||S^A - S^B||_op / 2 (not a certified bound or a confidence interval). No theorem bound (theorem_bound_status = UNAVAILABLE): the logistic transition spectra are unknown; finite TICA eigenvalues are never substituted for true rates.

evaluation_config.display_rule: per (unit, m) the curve is the maximal run of consecutive DK-applicable checkpoints from the first applicable one (b_logistic.curve_cutoffs); every checkpoint keeps its row and reason

covariance_source.protocol_32768: branched-pair Sigma_t-hat (german_credit_r2.branched_operator_stats): per batch N blocks, starts X / X' drawn with replacement from disjoint NUTS pool-run subsets (cross-check set <dataset>_nc_diag_reference_v1); halves = batches {0,1} vs {2,3}; shared NUTS pool -> reference bias unquantified
covariance_source.expanded_<N>: branched-pair Sigma_t-hat as the protocol tier; starts from the R2 pool with replacement (units without a new pool) or from the new bpool1 NUTS pools without replacement (German Credit hier, Australian; four run quarters give the X / X' subsets of the two halves); see expanded_config

features: 512 Nystrom landmarks (evenly spaced calibration draws), MAD-scaled RBF, saved R2 basis (german_credit_r2/main/<unit>_v1/setup.npz); fixed finite feature geometry, not full-RKHS angles
numerical_method: float64 throughout (GPU sampling and branched sums, CPU eigh); angles by the sine route sigma_max((I - V V^T) W)
margins: no numerical margin (empirical_sensitivity = e_t); budget-doubling check: half budgets {0,2} and {1,3} must be DK-applicable with angle(V_full, V_half) <= dk_full + dk_half

column_notes.budget: protocol_32768 = protocol tier (4 x 8192 blocks); expanded_<N> = expanded tier with N total blocks (4 batches)
column_notes.sin_theta / angle_deg: largest principal angle between the learned span and V_m(S_t-hat) (point estimate against the reference-estimated optimum)
column_notes.sin_uncertainty: sin of the DK term arcsin(e_t / (gap - e_t)) when DK applies (an empirical sensitivity of the angle to the reference optimum), else nan
column_notes.learned_angle_upper / learned_sin_upper: min(90, angle + DK term): empirical sensitivity envelope for the angle to V_m(S_t), nan where DK does not apply
column_notes.estimate_status: EMPIRICAL_SENSITIVITY_ONLY | TRIVIAL(EMPIRICAL_SENSITIVITY_ONLY) (envelope reaches 90 deg) | UNAVAILABLE (gap <= 2 e_t) | FAILED_FIT (no learned span)
column_notes.cutoff_reason: display rule (BEFORE_RESOLVED_WINDOW, FIRST_FAILED_CHECKPOINT, BEYOND_FIRST_FAILED_CHECKPOINT(t=..), NO_RESOLVED_CHECKPOINT) and per-row reasons (REFERENCE_GAP_UNRESOLVED; HALF_BUDGET_UNRESOLVED = a half budget is not DK-applicable, not an angular disagreement; HALF_BUDGET_ANGULAR_DISAGREEMENT = angle(V_full, V_half) > dk_full + dk_half)
column_notes.n_half_budget_inconsistent_displayed (st: displayed checkpoints whose budget-doubling check is not CONSISTENT = n_half_budget_unresolved_displayed + n_half_budget_disagreement_displayed
